skill-linkage-failure.description: Triggered when issue-to-project linkage fails and manual fallback is required.

node-id-mismatch.description: Triggered when cached board node IDs or field IDs mismatch GitHub API.

service-health-failure.description: Triggered when a core ecosystem service goes offline or fails healthchecks.

governance-violation.description: Triggered when an operation violates global/project policies or rules.

provisioning-token-rotation.description: Triggered when the PROVISIONING_TOKEN is close to expiration and needs rotation.

branch-not-cleaned-after-merge.description: Triggered when a branch remains uncleaned after PR merge.
